# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V2033 opaque_not_schema"
description: "A Schema bound (Json.decode, Sql.query rows, Llm.generate, Cli.parse, Tool.of arguments, a property parameter) reaches an opaque type outside its declaring module, directly or through a field (design §17.130)."
---

An error from the `type` phase. `sakura explain V2033` prints this explanation offline.

A `Schema` bound (`Json.decode`, `Sql.query` rows, `Llm.generate`, `Cli.parse`, `Tool.of`
arguments, a `property` parameter) reaches an opaque type outside its declaring module, directly
or through a field (design §17.130). Private construction comes in two kinds: an invariant that
is a predicate over the representation is a refinement type and decodes through its predicate
(`Uuid`, `Path`, `Decimal`); an invariant about how the value was produced (`Query<R>` from a
`sql"…"` literal, `Html` by escaping, `UrlPart` by encoding, `File` by the runtime) is opaque,
and data cannot build one. Decode the representation and call the module's constructor in the
open.

Wrong:

```sakura
type Report = { title: String, body: Html }
let r: Report = Json.decode(text)?
```

Fixed:

```sakura
type ReportIn = { title: String, body: String }
let r: ReportIn = Json.decode(text)?
let body = Html.text(r.body)
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V2033_decode_opaque_html.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V2033_decode_opaque_html.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
// The WS9.10 re-audit's second exploit: markup forged by decoding JSON into `Html`, then
// rendered through `html"…"`. `Html` is opaque outside `std/html`, so it is not `Schema` here.
import std/html.{Html}
import std/json.{DecodeError}

pub fn main() -> Unit ! {Console} {
  let forged: Result<Html, DecodeError> = Json.decode("\{\"Html\":\"<script>evil()</script>\"\}")
  match forged {
    Ok(h) => Console.print(Html.to_string(html"<p>{h}</p>")),
    Err(_) => Console.print("rejected"),
  }
}
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V2033_decode_opaque_html.fixed.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V2033_decode_opaque_html.fixed.sak), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:

```sakura
// Decode the representation (a `String`), then build the `Html` through its escaping
// constructor.
import std/html.{Html}
import std/json.{DecodeError}

pub fn main() -> Unit ! {Console} {
  let decoded: Result<String, DecodeError> = Json.decode("\"<script>evil()</script>\"")
  match decoded {
    Ok(s) => Console.print(Html.to_string(html"<p>{Html.text(s)}</p>")),
    Err(_) => Console.print("rejected"),
  }
}
```
